title: Dispute (v0)
description: Raisable by either party at ANY point in a Commitment's fulfillment window, not only at the end (docs/spec/05). Raising a dispute unconditionally freezes escrow. The protocol defines this state machine and the closed outcome vocabulary; the RESOLUTION POLICY (who's at fault, how much) is operator/governance territory (docs/spec/02 Layer C).

outcome.description: The closed vocabulary of terminal outcomes (docs/spec/05 §5). No operator policy may produce an outcome outside this set.

payouts.description: agent_id (or "platform") -> Money, summing to no more than the held escrow. Populated only once status is 'resolved' with a payout-bearing outcome (full_release/full_refund/partial); empty while 'escalated'.
